dz: 在马里的通迪比战役中,由犹大帕夏率领的萨达迪王朝的摩洛哥军队击败了松海帝国,尽管其人数至少被5比1所压倒.
de: At the Battle of Tondibi in Mali, Moroccan forces of the Saadi dynasty, led by Judar Pasha, defeat the Songhai Empire, despite being outnumbered by at least five to one.
